ratings_why.fun: Real turn puzzles: Chronicler wants 4 units at Start of Turn while Elder and Gottfried want gaps at End of Turn, and Herald, Cork-Pop and Altmark stack into a Champion who eats the enemy before the fight.
ratings_why.distinct: Empty slots as fuel and Proud gaps make board shape the resource, and Duel as a rite that skips Mire and Hunker plays unlike today's tribes, though 'grow one carry' is familiar.

verdict_why: The engine is good, but Hartmut with Cork-Pop and the open rules holes need one pass so the combos read as written.

points.text: With Master of the Cork-Pop, Sir Hartmut's win triggers twice; say whether each extra Duel spends one of his 'Twice a fight' uses, or the combo can't be read.
Settle the rules holes the design lists, above all whether Created units (Bird Egg, summons) break Proud, since half the tribe checks Proud every turn.

The Chronicler crossing out a full Ooze to empty its Belly, or a grown Squire Konrad, is the best off-purpose use in the tribe; a card that rewards being crossed out (not just sold) would give it a second feeder.
Bilberry Hen only pays the wide Duel build; if Hens also judged Proud units (say, a win by a Proud unit counts twice), the three builds would braid more.
Refectory Prior is plain gold that every player gets early; tie it to empty slots so it pays the Knights' own shape and not just turn 3.

standouts.why: Crowning any tribe's unit as Champion is a sanctioned off-purpose bridge: a huge Ooze or a returning Bird takes every Knight buff.
Herald turns empty slots into Champion Duels, and with Cork-Pop, Altmark and Ottokar each one compounds: the tribe's best combo hub.
Forces a buy-to-destroy rhythm against the Elder's gap rule, a real decision every turn.

weakest.why: Vanilla Duel body; nothing to combine it with beyond the Hen.
A generic Discover with a size check; it finds pieces but makes no interaction of its own.
Gold with a threshold everyone meets early; no tie to the tribe's shape.

flags.note: Cap wording against Cork-Pop doubling is unclear.
Herald plus Altmark plus Cork-Pop can wipe a front row and grow the Champion by half of each victim before attacks start.
x4 alone, x7 golden, on an already-fed Champion; the designer marks it broken on purpose.
